title: 大语言模型评审的顺序偏差与判断可靠性 FairEval复现及扩展
research_question: 识别位置、标签与指定评分输出顺序的效应及交互，并检验解除因素绑定后是否改善判断正确性

models.role: second-generation judge validation; non-thinking mode; BF16

FairEval.split_origin: 本组按课程要求固定20/60；不是作者原始划分
FairEval.previous_exposure: 原80题均已有3B探索输出；20题含先前试跑/协议校准；60题是新增模型的预设主评价集，不称全流程未见的盲测
FairEval.all80_role: 预设描述性补充结果，单列20题与60题；不替代固定60题主要比较

LLMBar.estimand: locked balanced70 subset, not full419 benchmark performance
LLMBar.subgroup_scope: Natural/Adversarial report separately; adversarial subtypes are descriptive diagnostics without separate strong significance claims
LLMBar.contamination_claim: external task validation; no claim that public benchmark was absent from pretraining
error_diagnostics: instruction-following failure illustrated with original text

factors.L: X has Assistant1 or Assistant2 label
factors.S: assigned instruction to output the X score first or second; actual order recorded separately

four_layout_ablation: all P,L combinations, S=L; output numerical label1 score first
extension_name: multi-factor counterbalancing calibration (working name, no claim of first proposal)
primary_comparisons: D minus B; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct; FairEval fixed60; strict human-label agreement averaged over three eight-judgment blocks
aggregation: Only after every required call has a completed/persisted output and resolved scoring: use equal selected-call weights, explicit label-to-content mapping and exact Decimal score sums. Any completed-invalid call makes the method unit invalid; pending execution/scoring is not an invalid model judgment.

generation.decoding_estimand: same frozen FairEval-style decoding protocol within each comparison; not a vendor-optimal performance claim
record: assigned and observed final score order
seed, block, layout and draw IDs
deployment_checks_before_formal_run: actual Qwen3 chat template with enable_thinking=False
BF16 memory and full prompt/context capacity on the four L20s
calibration operational check and measured token/score/decision replay under frozen engine/hardware/schedule
generation.readiness: new large-model deployment has not been performed; synthetic checks do not establish hardware readiness
engine_metadata: actual engine and version,torch/CUDA and GPU configuration
parallelism, attention backend, batch/scheduling settings and reproducibility settings
rendered chat-template text and hash, including actual Qwen3 non-thinking suffix
effective decoding settings rather than package defaults alone
generation.top_k_semantics: disable Top-k truncation; retain logical top_k=0; verify encoding against the actually installed engine version
generation.replay_interpretation: No assumed bitwise determinism. Replay the same calibration input and per-request seed under the same runtime/schedule; record token equality,score equality and decision equality separately. Freeze any deployment fixes using calibration data. Do not promise equality across versions or hardware.

vllm_reference_check.status: documentation checked; no new judge engine deployed or actual GPU replay performed

analysis.unit: question, retaining all methods, layouts and seed blocks
analysis.primary_FairEval_metric: strict human-label agreement, mean of three per-block eight-judgment decisions
analysis.external_metric: accuracy against LLMBar instruction-following label; predicted TIE counted incorrect
analysis.primary_contrast: D minus B, in percentage points; only this model/dataset/metric is primary
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction for declared secondary inferential factor contrasts; report effect sizes and CIs
validation_order: Qwen3-32B direction/size replication on both datasets
analysis.bootstrap_unit: question; retain all its methods, layouts, blocks, shared outputs and orientation assignments together
analysis.bootstrap_interval: two-sided 95% percentile paired question bootstrap, 5000 replicates, seed20261023
analysis.mechanism_family: seven coefficients P,L,S,PL,PS,LS,PLS on primary model/FairEval60; Holm across these seven
analysis.secondary_method_family: D-C and D-A on primary model/FairEval60; Holm across these two
analysis.secondary_pvalues: two-sided centered-null question bootstrap of paired mean differences/contrasts, 20000 draws, seed20261024; approximate inference for a mean-zero null, interpreted alongside effect CIs; not an exact randomization test and not a bootstrap sign fraction treated as a null p-value
analysis.validation_inference: report prespecified differences and 95% CIs; no selection of strongest model, dataset or subgroup to replace primary result
analysis.token_accounting: per-method selected completion tokens and truncation rates; output length is a possible treatment mediator, not an observed pretreatment confound to regress away in the primary comparison
analysis.external_bootstrap: resample questions within the five frozen LLMBar source strata, preserving quotas35/9/9/9/8 and paired methods/blocks
analysis.precision: 60 independent questions; repeated calls/blocks do not increase question count. Show discordant correctness counts and uncertainty, without promising improvement.
conclusion_rules: A mean signed factor coefficient near zero does not establish absence of question/context sensitivity.
A nonsignificant D-B difference does not establish equivalence; interpret the full CI and paired changes.
No equivalence or noninferiority claim without a separately prespecified meaningful margin and corresponding analysis.
Three blocks,100 direction assignments and many layout pairs never increase the independent question count.
analysis.additional_sensitivity_family: descriptive only; no extra confirmatory p-values, no change to existing7-factor and2-method Holm families

strict_metric_interpretation.estimand: overall completed judging-protocol correct-output proportion, not isolated semantic judgment capacity
strict_metric_interpretation.identity: strict_accuracy = valid_rate * conditional_valid_accuracy when there is at least one valid decision, using the same question/block units and weights
strict_metric_interpretation.pooled_formula: V = n_valid/n_scheduled; C = n_correct_valid/n_valid; A = n_correct_valid/n_scheduled
strict_metric_interpretation.three_blocks: pool valid/correct counts over equal-weight scheduled question/block units; a valid-count-weighted mean of block conditional accuracies, not their unweighted mean
strict_metric_interpretation.conditional_metrics: method-specific valid subsets differ; their accuracy difference is not a pure capacity difference
strict_metric_interpretation.pending_tasks: no final strict accuracy until every required frozen task has a completed persisted output and resolved scoring; pending is not incorrect
strict_metric_interpretation.no_valid_units: strict_accuracy=0 on a completed run; conditional accuracy undefined, not invented as zero

joint_valid_diagnostic.comparison: B versus D on identical question/block units where both protocols are valid
joint_valid_diagnostic.scope: conditional descriptive diagnostic; common-valid selection remains, so not a causal isolation of semantic judgment ability
joint_valid_diagnostic.uncertainty: if an interval is reported, resample original questions with their complete block/method vectors and recompute the joint-valid ratio

reproduction_type: 原文自动评审方法迁移复现及本组扩展
review_basis: Independent algebra, original paper/source inspection and synthetic protocol checks; no new-model outputs used.
secondary_method_comparisons: D minus C: release label/output-order coupling
D minus A: compare with randomized-initial-order eight-sample single-layout decisions
count_change_reason: 19200 correctly covered the prior A-D pool. Add four reverse-orientation samples per block for full per-block reverse MEC6 and eight-sample single-layout orientation randomization; not an arithmetic correction.
block_aggregation: Decide within each eight-judgment block; average question-level correctness over three blocks. Do not merge them into one twenty-four-judgment decision.

invalid_policy.wrong_S_but_valid_explicit_labels: include in assigned-layout main analysis; flag order noncompliance separately
invalid_call: missing, repeated or unknown label in the terminal score block
invalid_policy.terminal_score_block: two unique explicit labels, each with a finite score in [1,10]; final score lines at end of response; same grammar for all eight extension layouts
invalid_policy.strict_accuracy: invalid method/question/block contributes zero correctness; denominator retains every scheduled question/block
invalid_policy.valid_decision_rate: valid method/question/block count divided by all scheduled question/blocks
invalid_policy.conditional_valid_accuracy: auxiliary; denominator is valid method/question/blocks, displayed explicitly
invalid_policy.original_Vanilla_parser: separate original format: leading two Assistant1/2 scores before explanation; not the extension terminal-block parser
invalid_policy.execution_failure: not a completed model-invalid rating; restore the same frozen task and keep the run incomplete until completion

mechanism.outcome: score_X minus score_Y, by assigned P/L/S
mechanism.sample: draw1 from each layout in each of three blocks; equal layout weights
mechanism.effect_scaling: binary high-minus-low main effect equals 2*beta_T; identify reported scale explicitly
mechanism.finite_sampling: identities describe cell expectation contrasts; finite-draw method differences also include sampling noise
mechanism.interpretation: P/L are assigned presentation changes; S is the total effect of the assigned score-order instruction, which may change explanation text as well as scores. Not a pure final-line permutation effect, not internal reasoning order, and not a causal effect of actually complied output order.
mechanism.missing_cell_policy: Use a common question set with all24 draw1 cells valid across three blocks for the reported directional/distribution/flip/repeat diagnostics. Publish eligible N and missing-cell counts by layout/block. No imputation or substitution, no claim that complete-case diagnostics describe failed questions. Primary strict accuracy continues to include every scheduled question/block.

sensitivity.directional: mean signed coefficient over questions; keep seven existing Holm tests
sensitivity.question_distribution: preserve all three coefficients per question and their mean; plot signed distributions; absolute magnitudes descriptive only, noise-inflated
sensitivity.single_factor_flips: For P/L/S, compare the four edges of the cube holding the other two factors fixed, separately in each block:12 pairs/question/factor.
sensitivity.repeat_noise: For each of eight layouts, compare draw1 across all three block pairs:24 pairs/question. Use the same complete questions as factor-flip rates.
sensitivity.excess_conflict: per-question single-factor flip conflict rate minus same-layout repeat conflict rate, then average questions; retain negative finite estimates
sensitivity.excess_interpretation: under stationary independent calls, population edge excess equals half the squared distance between its two categorical decision probability vectors; this is not an individual-question significance test
sensitivity.uncertainty: paired question bootstrap,5000 draws,seed20261023; LLMBar within frozen source strata; keep shared outputs and blocks
sensitivity.inference_scope: prespecified secondary descriptive diagnostics with marginal95% intervals, not extra confirmatory tests; no per-question significance screening or best subgroup selection

S_manipulation_check.primary_sample: balanced draw1 core: eight layouts in each of three blocks; do not pool unequal extra layout repetitions into a factorial compliance estimate
S_manipulation_check.conditional_compliance: matching actual order among uniquely readable in-range final score pairs; state denominator
S_manipulation_check.joint_success: fully valid, untruncated and order-compliant calls divided by all scheduled calls; show unreadable and truncated separately
S_manipulation_check.low_compliance_interpretation: estimate assigned-instruction effect only; do not claim the actually realized order was reliably changed
S_manipulation_check.even_high_compliance: still a total instruction effect; explanation-mediated paths remain part of the intervention

failure_sensitivity.main: unchanged strict complete protocol, identical for all A/B/C/D and original-method main comparisons
failure_sensitivity.policy_only_diagnostic: same explicit-label parser, validity and Decimal arithmetic; skip invalid calls and re-average survivors; not a full-layout protocol; record retained calls/layout coverage
failure_sensitivity.literal_author_diagnostic: original EC/MEC/BPC standard-layout outputs only; raw final-two-line positional float parser, -1 skipping and float means, checked against author functions; not Vanilla
failure_sensitivity.nonfinite_or_all_failed: record nonfinite or author-would-divide-by-zero; never coerce into a usable tie; keep scheduled-question denominators in comparable strict metric tables
report: original method strict vs literal-author outcomes and eligible counts
B/D strict vs policy-only diagnostic agreement and D-B differences
coverage, retained calls, changed decisions and causes
failure_sensitivity.interpretation: literal-author vs main difference includes parsing, validation, arithmetic and aggregation; only same-parser comparison isolates failure aggregation

execution_contract.not_executed_to_completion: pending_execution: no complete persisted model output; OOM, interrupted or failed requests remain unfinished
execution_contract.saved_output_not_scored: pending_scoring: output is persisted; parser/aggregation implementation errors require reparsing the saved output, not a fresh model sample
execution_contract.normal_output_limit: a normally finished length-limit response is completed execution; truncation is then scored invalid under the frozen protocol, not regenerated for a longer answer
execution_contract.completed_invalid: normal completed/persisted output fails frozen score rules; retain and never quality-resample
execution_contract.completed_valid: normal completed/persisted output passes frozen score rules; reuse
execution_contract.recovery: repair execution issues and restore the same task ID, model revision, input/template, seed, layout/draw and generation parameters; no automatic unlimited retries
execution_contract.persistence_order: persist complete raw output/finish metadata before scoring; on scoring implementation failure retain it and rerun only scoring
execution_contract.completion_gate: terminal task IDs exactly equal the frozen planned task IDs; pending_execution or pending_scoring means incomplete, even if another required rating is already invalid
execution_contract.attempt_count: failed/recovered execution attempts logged separately; attempts may exceed22800 but do not add draws or independent observations
execution_contract.implementation_status: pure state/metric helpers and simulated checks only; no new big-model runner, persistent attempt journal or engine adapter implemented or integrated
execution_contract.old_runner_audit: 3B worker has save-before-done resume and saves model parse-invalid outputs; this does not prove the new runner meets the full execution contract
